# OpenVolo

> Agentic AI-Native Social CRM — manage contacts, content, and workflows across X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and Gmail, with AI agents, a chat assistant, and a full analytics dashboard. All data stays on your machine.

## Key Features

- **Zero Install**: One command (`npx openvolo`) sets up everything — database, migrations, and dashboard
- **Local-First Privacy**: All data stored in SQLite at ~/.openvolo/ with AES-256 encrypted credentials
- **Unified Contacts**: Cross-platform contact management with automatic deduplication, enrichment scoring, and linked task management
- **Workflow Engine**: Six workflow types — sync, enrich, search, prune, sequence, and agent — with a template gallery, kanban views, and per-step cost tracking
- **AI Agent Runner**: Five specialized tools — web fetch, browser scrape, smart search, contact enrichment, and progress tracking — with domain-based routing
- **AI Chat Assistant**: Conversational AI panel (Cmd+K) with 8 CRM tools for querying contacts, analytics, workflows, and content
- **Analytics Dashboard**: Five-tab dashboard — overview, agents, engagement, content, and sync health — with time-range filtering and six chart types
- **Content Library**: Create and manage posts, threads, articles, newsletters, DMs, and replies — publish across X, LinkedIn, and Gmail from one place
- **Smart Search**: Dual-provider search with Brave and Tavily, intelligent query routing, and 3,000 free queries per month

## Supported Platforms

- X/Twitter (OAuth, data sync, publishing, engagement tracking, content library)
- LinkedIn (OAuth, OpenID Connect, profile sync, CSV import, browser enrichment)
- Gmail (Google People API contact sync, email metadata enrichment, message composition)

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 + React 19 (frontend)
- SQLite + Drizzle ORM (local database)
- Vercel AI SDK + Claude Agent SDK (AI features)
- Playwright (browser scraping)
- Recharts (analytics charts)
- Brave Search + Tavily (smart search)
- OAuth 2.0 (platform authentication)

## How It Works

1. **Install**: Run `npx openvolo` — no config files, no Docker, no dependencies
2. **Connect**: Link X, LinkedIn, and Gmail accounts with OAuth (credentials encrypted locally)
3. **Automate**: Build workflows, run AI agents, query everything with the chat assistant, and track results on the analytics dashboard
